english.title: Fail to stop a vehicle when required for a search in anticipation of violence

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: CRIMINAL JUSTICE AND PUBLIC ORDER ACT

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to stop

(A)_[a vehicle,]_
(B)_[a ship,]_
(C)_[an aircraft,]_
(D)_[a hovercraft,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY..), when required to do so by a constable in uniform exercising powers to stop and search under section 60 of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994
english.legislation: Contrary to section 60(8)(a) of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
fail to stop
vehicle/ship/aircraft/hovercraft
when required to do so
constable in uniform
exercise powers of stop/search

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence cannot be used until the appropriate powers of a police Superintendent have been exercised. See Section 60(1) which sets out powers of a police Superintendent (or other senior officer, where relevant) and the appropriate circumstances for exercising these powers.
(ii) 'Vehicle' includes caravan.
(iii) See offence wording H352 for person failing to stop.

other.penalty:
One month imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level three on the legislative standard scale
